comparison.objective: Spread butter over fragile bread while holding the loose slice stationary; candidate fractures four installed HELICOIL tangs and retrieves the fragments.
comparison.physical_skill: Gentle bimanual spreading and deformable-object stabilization versus coaxial mandrel placement, controlled hammer impacts, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Evenly buttered, untorn bread and knife removed versus four notch fractures, all tangs contained, inserts and shell undamaged, and stable tool release.
comparison.reason: The tested abilities and outcomes differ meaningfully: compliant spreading without tearing does not test impact fracture, retained-insert protection, or fragment accounting.
